description.zh: 一个围绕唱片封面排版的小型交互概念：选择模板，调整文字、布局与配色，再导出 PNG。项目包含六款图形模板与一款照片窗口模板。此处展示当前本地 V2 原型；照片模板中的默认建筑图为 AI 生成示例，不属于个人摄影。
description.en: A compact interaction concept for making record sleeves: choose an edition, adjust type, layout and colour, then export a PNG. It contains six graphic templates and one photo-window template. These captures show the current local V2 prototype. The default architectural image in the photo template is an AI-generated demo, not personal photography.

role.zh: 个人概念项目 · 视觉方向、交互取舍与迭代；Figma Make 生成初稿，AI 编程辅助本地精修。
role.en: Personal concept · visual direction, interaction decisions and iteration; an initial Figma Make prototype refined locally with AI coding assistance.

description.zh: 以照片盒、环境声机和纸条盒组成的复古桌面概念。窗口、纸质物件与 OFF DUTY 场景构成一段轻量的浏览体验。图片是署名保留的第三方 Unsplash 示例，声音是合成氛围示例；这里展示的是界面与交互设计，不作为本人摄影或实地录音作品。
description.en: A retro desktop concept made of a photo box, an ambient sound machine and paper keepsakes. Windows, paper objects and an OFF DUTY scene create a small browsing experience. The images are credited third-party Unsplash demos and the audio is synthesised ambience. This project presents interface and interaction design, not personal photography or field recordings.

role.zh: 个人概念项目 · 视觉选择、交互方向与响应式迭代；Figma Make 与 AI 编程辅助实现。
role.en: Personal concept · visual selection, interaction direction and responsive iteration, realised with Figma Make and AI coding assistance.

subtitle.zh: 光与纸艺 · 数字展览研究
subtitle.en: A study in light · digital exhibition concept

caption.zh: 视觉方向图 · AI 辅助生成的概念素材，尚非运行界面
caption.en: Art-direction study · AI-assisted concept imagery, not a running interface

description.zh: 围绕褶皱灯具与纸艺舞台发展的互动数字展览研究。目前已准备视觉方向、分层素材与交互方案，网页实现尚在进行中。图像为 AI 辅助生成的概念素材；灯具未制造，也不是实际品牌委托。
description.en: An interactive exhibition study around a pleated lamp and a paper stage. Art direction, layered assets and an interaction plan have been prepared; web implementation is still in progress. Images are AI-assisted concept assets. The lamp has not been manufactured and this is not a commissioned brand project.

role.zh: 个人概念研究 · 艺术指导、素材组织与交互规划，AI 辅助视觉生成。
role.en: Personal concept study · art direction, asset organisation and interaction planning with AI-assisted image generation.
